result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure and there is a minor styling inconsistency between favorite buttons on the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white/very light type on a pale mint-green background, making them nearly illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark green or near-black text color on the light green banner (or darken the banner background) to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, size and icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The promo banner's headline and CTA are visually unbalanced — the 'Order now' button uses strong green text while the headline above is barely visible, so the hierarchy reads backwards.
issues.suggestion: Emphasize the headline with a bolder, darker color so it dominates the banner and the button remains a secondary accent.
